items.name: 100,000 Steps
items.flavor: "While many Barbarians remained in the Dreadlands, small groups from the Oxen, Crane, and Bear tribes instead chose to search the land for a new home." -A History of the Children of Bul-Kathos

items.name: Bane of Ahjad-Den
items.flavor: Before Baal's hosts blighted Daken-Shar, the outnumbered northmen clad themselves in barbed mail so that even in death, the demons still bled.

items.flavor: "The fever racks my body. It dances... rhythmless, endless! I fear there is but one remedy. MORE! I must hear more..." -Lester the Farmer

items.name: Bindings of Attrition
items.flavor: "What is more perfect than blood? A single drop can consecrate, empower, or curse. Know this: The most potent form is not blood stolen from others, but given from one's self." -Elias

items.name: Black River
items.flavor: "The scrolls describe a river of tar that separated the living from the land of the dead. Any unfortunate soul who tried to cross would be dragged down into oblivion." -Notes of Scholar Kamien

items.flavor: "The infamous Necromancer Gaza-Thul's mastery over blood magic was indisputable. Many suspect that upon his death, his skin was used to fashion this eldritch armor." -Barrett's Book of Implements

items.name: Blood Moon Breeches
items.flavor: A naturally occurring curiosity, the blood moon persists as a sign of woe for the most superstitious Zakarum faithful. Children born under it are often considered cursed and cast out, lest it spread.

items.name: Blood Wake
items.flavor: "These Priests of Rathma are quite peculiar. Is it possible to dabble in the forbidden yet uphold Balance? Too often, the power of such magic leads to corruption." –The Writings of Abd al-Hazir

items.flavor: "The relic was fashioned for the broken-hearted and the battle-mad, for those whose rage has nowhere left to dwell." - Notes from Sister Octavia on the Burnt Knights

items.name: Bridle of Tor'Baalos
items.flavor: "Destruction can be become an addiction, it is said. The first taste of it leaves you wanting more. Something within us craves ruin, yearns for annihilation." -Black Book of Lam Esen

items.name: Bucrani's Grip
items.flavor:
"Kin of Bo'a, beloved of Bucrani,
Whose path led into the wine-dark pasture.
The victor's sword swings for this alone,
To lop off all thought and memory–a final mercy."
Low of Bo'a, Verse 50-54

items.name: Bucrani's Resolve
items.flavor: "...In those days, the children of Bucrani were known to many. Great was their sway, and mighty was their squall! How could any realm hold such strong souls?" -Oxridge, Common Histories, fragment II

items.name: Bucrani's Tread
items.flavor:
"Changing, consuming, becoming: this is the way of all life.
I give myself to you, my children, so that you may live."
Low of Bo'a, Verse 112-113

items.name: Bucrani's Will
items.flavor: The leather feels warm to the touch, as through life clings to it. A divine purpose still trembles in each fold.

items.name: Cage of Madness
items.flavor: "Sin begets sins as men beget men. Terror begets Hate and Hate begets Destruction. Destruction begets Terror as Terror begets Hate..." -Inscription carved inside the helm

items.name: Cowl of Malefic Torment
items.flavor: "The doomed do not fall at once. They linger, falter in purpose, and then unravel. Breath shortens. Will erodes. Fortune abandons them. When death finally comes, 'tis merely overdue." -Warlord Bartuc

items.flavor:
"He is banished from the Guild, his name stricken from the Book. His punishment is to never have been." 
- Excerpt from a burned parchment

items.name: Craze of the Dead God
items.flavor: T'an seized a spear and drove it thrice into his mad brother Tan. Alas, the craftier of the twin gods wove one last cunning snare. In place of blood, the wound wept venom and consumed all in its wake.

items.name: Crown of Lucion
items.flavor: The prince of Hatred, fair as maggots over carrion. He claims no throne, crafts no realms, reigning over only a blackened, bitter heart. Some legends name him banished, while others dread his return.

items.name: Cruor's Embrace
items.flavor:
In the blood dancer's grasp, a victim lies,
A vessel dried 'neath darkened skies.
Their life extinguished, veins burst and drained,
In Cruor's embrace, forever enchained.

items.name: Dark Howl
items.flavor: "They who live by fang and claw forget the feeling of human feet on soil. Of cold air on bare skin. Man and beast...thoughts, desires...merge together like blood spilled in a stream." -Nafain

items.name: Dark Stalker's Medallion
items.flavor: "Tried dying once. Didn't care for it." -Renit the Dark Stalker

items.name: Dark Stalker's Medallion

items.name: Dawnfire
items.flavor: "Kindle your inner flame. With it, we are the dawn that breaks the night." - Paladin Justelle

items.name: Death's Pavane
items.flavor: "The assassin moved as though in a dance - left, pivot, cut. The guests did not realize they had been split until their screams gurgled through the slits in their necks." - An Account at the Red Feast

items.name: Deathgrip
items.flavor: "There is something akin to desire that I have sensed in the dead. A longing to serve, to be of purpose in their new state of being. Do not deny them that purpose." -Books of Kalan

items.name: Deathless Visage
items.flavor: "Rathma is endless. He was the first Ancient, and will remain at the end. He is the master of the Great Cycle of Being. When Death comes for him, why should he fear it?" -Vauntus, Acolyte of Rathma

items.name: Desperate March
items.flavor:
"My feet do not ache—there is no greater pain than stopping.
Into the Abyss I go. I will find her. I will bring her home. 
Hell cannot keep me from her, but it is welcome to try."
- Unknown

items.name: Footfalls of the Waning World
items.flavor: Step onward, and the living realm shall dim behind thee as the Black Road uncoils, eternal and cold. Even death shall fail to follow thee there.

items.name: Fractured Runestone
items.flavor: "The runestones in Scosglen are fascinating. Some act as wards, but others are conduits. They tap into the deepest power of the earth itself." -Donan

items.name: Fractured Winterglass
items.flavor: Winterglass refracts light and also manipulates mana - forming complex arrays of spells and enchantments. These distinct characteristics possess great power, yet the outcomes remain unpredictable.

items.name: Gate of the Red Dawn
items.flavor: Between fire and darkness, I hold the gate.

items.name: Gathlen's Birthright
items.flavor: 'Twas Gathlen, most tender warden of the elder realm, who reigneth o'er grove and glade. Whosoever he favors shall inherit the wilds. Utter his name, and be embraced.

items.name: Gauntlets of Sheol
items.flavor: All of Abaddon is unshrouded before you. The denizens of Sheol tremble, for these hands are the touch of those unutterable ruins.

items.name: Gift of Frost
items.flavor: Legend says those who survive the Hall of Mirrors emerge forever changed, able to enchant objects with an innate cold.

items.name: Gladiator's Triumph
items.flavor: The Philios Games were said to welcome the prideful, the reckless, and the condemned.

items.name: Gladiator's Triumph

items.name: Gloves of the Illuminator
items.flavor: After Inarius returned to Sanctuary, he sought a way back to the High Heavens. His first step was to reignite the religion he had abandoned millennia before: the Cathedral of Light.

items.name: Godly Plate of the Whale
items.flavor: "Seen a whale once. Big thing. Bigger'n Ogden's whole damned inn! And this plate - you put it on, nothin' can hurt you! Nothin'! 'Cept...maybe the whale. Don't go fightin' the whale." -Farnham

items.name: Godslayer Crown
items.flavor:
"The Sahptev faithful believe in a thousand and one gods. If it takes me as many lifetimes, I will find and kill them all."
- Gaspar Stilbian, Veradani Outcast

items.name: Greaves of the Empty Tomb
items.flavor: "The massive door to my family's crypt, which had taken a dozen men to close, was thrown open. Had I known the horrors to come I never would have set foot inside!" -The Ebon Pages, Canto I, Verse VII

items.name: Greenwalker's Oath
items.flavor: Ciódan was known to be a true friend of the Deep Forest. In gratitude, he was protected fiercely by nature itself.

items.name: Greenwalker's Signet
items.flavor:
"Do not speak to nature. Listen to it. Learn from it. That is the only true path of knowledge."
-Code of the Scéal Fada

items.name: Griswold's Opus
items.flavor: Griswold created wonders at his anvil. But, none ever stilled his hands - for every new blade bore dissatisfaction. Though his final work was left unfinished, it was hailed as his greatest.

items.name: Hail of Verglas
items.flavor: "Ere the age of mage and king, storms raged so dread and fell that men named it the wrath of gods. Its hail smote the earth till mountains were wrought..." -Tome recovered from Kasama

items.name: Hand of Apotheosis
items.flavor: "There are certain thresholds one must not cross. Not because the demonologist will lose their way back, but because they will not return the same as they were before." -Grimoire of Reckoning

items.name: Hands of the Worldbreaker
items.flavor: "For demons whose nature is to destroy, where does it end? If everything around them is brought to ruin, I believe their final act of destruction would be themselves." -Deckard Cain

items.name: Hangman's Hand
items.flavor: "The executioner's hands are imprinted with the essence of every life they have taken. They do not understand this, though. But we who seek Balance do." -Books of Kalan

items.name: Harlequin Crest
items.flavor:
"This headdress was once worn by an assassin disguised as a court mage. Her treachery was unveiled, but not before she used its magic to curse the king's entire lineage."
- The Fall of House Aston

items.flavor: Only Ebewaka has walked amid a dozen Guardians. In death, they waged war for his spirit, yet none prevailed. Thus, the Guardians shared dominion, granting Ebewaka to roam freely amid all their realms.

items.name: Heart of Azgar
items.flavor: "You kept us from harm. Forever will you hold a place of honor. We will always look up to you...brother." -Grey of Clan Skeld

items.name: Hecaton Chasm
items.flavor: "The creatures of Hell are craven, wretched things, clawing at scraps like mongrels. Hells' hundred hands do not fight. They clamber forward like cowards in the dark." -Tal Rasha

items.name: Heir of Perdition
items.flavor: Beware false prophets donned as sheep yet bearing the stench of wolves. Thou shalt know them by their fruits. For a tree of good cannot produce evil, nor thorns yield a harvest sweet and fair.

items.name: Hellbrand Signet
items.flavor: "The fire of that realm is not like the fire of our world. It seems alive. Not mindless, but imbued with purpose. As if it were blood flowing through unknowable veins." -Jere Harash

items.name: Hellhammer
items.flavor: The demon prince Ikonoth slew hundreds of the Heavenly Host with this infernal hammer before falling to none other than the Archangel Imperius himself.

items.name: Hellhound's Sabatons
items.flavor: "As loyal as we may think they might be, they are still demons. And they will take any chance they can to destroy us." -Book of Adria

items.name: Henri's Perquisition
items.flavor: "It's just a cat," said Ankaj. Her uncle leaned in, "You are spiritborn. Look deeper." In its amber eyes, Ankaj saw the passing of ages, fixed on a single thought: "Mouse." The cat smacked its lips.

items.name: Herald of Zakarum
items.flavor: "Praise Akarat, His will be done. Lead us to darkness, so our Light may shine and purify." - Zakarum prayer

items.name: Herald's Morningstar
items.flavor: First in the Swan, the Herald by name. This is the star of morning that shines brightest, which marshals the order of all other celestial bodies.

items.name: Hesha e Kesungi
items.flavor: Wreathed in bark and bone, these gauntlets carry the strength of old simian spirits - wardens of root and canopy.

items.name: Howl from Below
items.flavor: "Can you not hear it? That endless scream from the cold earth beneath your feet!? They are down there, trapped, blind with rage! Waiting to drag us down into the sod!" -Ravings of Madman Gustav

items.name: Hunter's Zenith
items.flavor:
"By fang, claw, spear, or sword - send the bastards back to the flames from which they crawled! Soak the peat with their blood! For Fiacla-Géar! For Scosglen!"
- Nafain, during the Days of Ash

items.name: Iceheart Brais
items.flavor: The mad artisan saw his fingers turn black from frostbite as he worked the cloth, but refused to stay the needle and thread for even a moment.

items.name: Ifeh's Dire Totem
items.flavor: Fiacla-Géar's druids lived in harmony with nature. The Talons of Ifeh walked a different path. They surrendered their souls to the wilds, becoming more beast than man.

items.name: In-Geom
items.flavor: "Ahh, the In-Geom! The royal smiths of Xiansai folded the spirits of not one—but four tigers into the steel! Come! Put your ear to its edge. You can almost hear them... Meow!" -Covetous Shen

items.name: Indira's Memory
items.flavor: "The tears of Linarian turned bloody over Indira's torn body. Many days, unyielding, he poured his magic into sundered bone and rended sinew. Though the flesh did mend, his beloved did not rise..."

items.name: Infernal Homunculus
items.flavor: It grows restless in silence, thrashing against its bindings. Though the body is small, it dreams of carnage unimaginable.

items.name: Insatiable Fury

In the Sunless Depths, Kabraxis wailed.
No vessel could bare the Imprisoned Lord.
Creation could not sustain the road he traveled, only madness remained.

items.flavor: "Too soon she was taken, yet Rathma let Kessime rest in death, for they both had found peace in the cycle. Upon the hill where she lay, Rathma poured forth his blood and no evil trod thereafter..."

items.name: Khamsin Steppewalkers

items.name: Sea Lord's Fine Gloves

items.name: Seal of the Diamond Mind
items.flavor: "Every facet, precise. Each turn of the stone, a symphony of refracted light. How miraculous the properties? How thrilling the possibilities?" -Zoltun Kulle

items.name: Seal of the Golden Epiphany
items.flavor: "I know what I must do. Phoba, Fer, Mlor, aligned upon a single, terrible course. Yet despite myself, I find the certainty not only comforting but beautiful in its simplicity." -Tal Rasha

items.name: Seal of the Ophanim
items.flavor: Upon the seal was graven the Name of the Ophanim. And though they were not demon, their will bent the same.

items.name: Seal of the Second Trumpet
items.flavor: "So is it written: when the Second Trumpet sounds, the wicked shall fall as stars cast down from their firmament." - Canticle of the Judgement, Verse XII

items.name: Seal of the Severed Finger
items.flavor: "It is a small sacrifice. But who would not regard their own hand and prefer it remain whole? Even against the promise of such power?" -Elias of Aranoch

items.name: Seed of Horazon
items.flavor: "In all dealings with Hells' spawn, names are both key and chain. To speak a demon's true name is to invite its presence, and seize some small dominion over it." -Master Horazon

items.flavor: "While known for their proclivity for mischief, the Sidhe, as the Druids call them, are fiercely loyal and will defend all they consider friend..."  - Sarnakyle

legendary_spiritborn_012_x1.t: Enemies you Poison have {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100|%|]{/c} Reduced Healing and your {c_important}Eagle{/c} Skills gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%+|]{/c} increased Critical Strike Chance and {c_number}[Affix_Value_2*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage against them.

legendary_spiritborn_013_x2.t: Your Maximum {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} stacks are increased by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1]{/c}.

legendary_spiritborn_014_x1.t: Your Knock Downs cause enemies to take {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} damage from you for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds.

legendary_spiritborn_015_x1.t:
Gain {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0" * 100|%+|]{/c} increased Dodge Chance during {c_important}Evade{/c}.

Whenever you {c_important}Evade{/c} or use a Non-{c_important}Basic{/c} {c_important}Mobility{/c} Skill, you gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%x|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance and  {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100*Affix."Static Value 2"|%x|]{/c} Movement Speed for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds.

legendary_spiritborn_016_x1.t: {c_important}{u}Pestilent Swarms{/u}{/c} deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage, last {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%|]{/c} longer, and spiral outwards.

legendary_spiritborn_017_x1.t: {c_important}Payback{/c} now echoes forward and additionally deals {c_random}[Affix_Value_1 * 100|%|]{/c} of your Thorns damage to enemies.

legendary_spiritborn_018_x1.t: {c_important}Centipede{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|1%x|]{/c} increased damage, further increased to {c_random}[Affix_Value_2*100|1%x|]{/c} against Crowd Controlled enemies.

legendary_spiritborn_019_x1.t: When you Dodge or Block an attack you trigger a {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c} Thorns attack against the attacker.

legendary_spiritborn_020_x1.t: Your Poisoning effects cause enemies to take {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c} of your Thorns damage per second.

legendary_spiritborn_021_x1.t: Gain increased Critical Strike Damage equal to {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|x%|]{/c} of your Block Chance. Blocking doubles this bonus for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds.

legendary_spiritborn_022_x1.t: Whenever an enemy hits you, your Dodge Chance against that enemy increases by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%1+|]{/c}. Successfully Dodging resets this bonus.

legendary_spiritborn_023_x1.t: {c_important}Ravager{/c} no longer has a duration and instead drains {c_random}[Affix_Value_1]{/c} Vigor every second until depleted. Effects which extend {c_important}Ravager{/c} instead generate Vigor.

legendary_spiritborn_024_x1.t: Your {c_important}Eagle{/c} Skill damage is increased by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|1%x|]{/c} of your Movement Speed.

legendary_spiritborn_025_x1.t:
Casting a {c_important}Focus{/c} Skill recalls all Nearby {c_important}{u}Storm Feathers{/u}{/c}, dealing {c_random}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * Affix_Value_1 * (1+Owner.Bonus_Percent_Per_Power#Spiritborn_Feather_Spawn)]{/c} Lightning damage to enemies along their way. 

If there are no Nearby {c_important}{u}Storm Feathers{/u}{/c}, the cast instead spawns {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} randomly around you.

legendary_spiritborn_025_x2.t:
Casting a {c_important}Focus{/c} Skill recalls all Nearby {c_important}{u}Storm Feathers{/u}{/c}, dealing {c_random}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * Affix_Value_1 * (1+Owner.Bonus_Percent_Per_Power#Spiritborn_Feather_Spawn)]{/c} Lightning damage and makes enemies {u}{c_important}Vulnerable{/c}{/u} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds. 

If you recall no {c_important}{u}Storm Feathers{/u}{/c}, spawn {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} around you.

legendary_spiritborn_026_x1.t: When you cast the {c_number}3rd{/c} attack of your {c_important}Basic{/c} Skills you have a {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c} chance to unleash {c_important}Payback{/c}.

legendary_spiritborn_027_x1.t:
{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Up to a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%+|]{/c} chance to create a {c_important}Mystic Circle{/c} for {c_number}[PowerTag.Spiritborn_RuneArea."Script Formula 5"]{/c} seconds. 

Casting a {c_important}Jaguar{/c} Skill in {c_important}Mystic Circles{/c} empowers them to refresh {c_important}{u}Ferocity's{/u}{/c} duration and increase your damage by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1 * (1 + Owner.Bonus_Percent_Per_Power#Spiritborn_RuneArea)|%x1|]{/c} per stack while you remain within.

legendary_spiritborn_028_x1.t:
Gain {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100|%+|]{/c} Block Chance. 
Blocking an attack from an enemy has a {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c} chance to invoke a free {c_important}Concussive Stomp{/c} at them.

legendary_spiritborn_029_x1.t: Your {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} has a {c_random}[Affix_Value_1 * 100|%|]{/c} chance to not be lost when you are hit for each stack of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} you have. Gain {c_number}[Affix_Value_2*100|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction.

legendary_spiritborn_030_x1.t: Losing a stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} has a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]%{/c} chance to Heal you for {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life.

legendary_spiritborn_031_x1.t: While active, {c_important}Counterattack{/c} reflects incoming {c_important}Razor Wings{/c} back out again with {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c} increased damage. Other Small Missiles are also deflected back at enemies and deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c} of {c_important}Counterattack's{/c} Base damage on impact.

legendary_spiritborn_032_x1.t: You gain {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} for each {c_random}[Affix_Value_1]{/c} Vigor you gain while at Maximum Vigor. This can overfill your {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} stacks.

legendary_spiritborn_033_x1.t: Your Blocked Damage Reduction is increased by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%+|]{/c}.

legendary_spiritborn_035_x1.t:
{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Up to a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%+|]{/c} chance to create a {c_important}Mystic Circle{/c} for {c_number}[PowerTag.Spiritborn_RuneArea."Script Formula 5"]{/c} seconds. 

Casting a {c_important}Gorilla{/c} Skill in {c_important}Mystic Circles{/c} empowers them to periodically grant you a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life which increases your Armor by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1 * (1 + Owner.Bonus_Percent_Per_Power#Spiritborn_RuneArea)|%+|]{/c} while active.

legendary_spiritborn_036_x1.t: When you cast an {c_important}Incarnate{/c} Skill enemies around you become {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds. Killing a {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} enemy echoes {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c} of the killing blow's damage to another Nearby enemy.

legendary_spiritborn_037_x1.t:
Casting a Non-{c_important}Basic{/c} {c_important}Mobility{/c} Skill grants {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}.

Casting a {c_important}Defensive{/c} Skill with {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} increases its damage by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1 * 100 |%x|]{/c}.

legendary_spiritborn_038_x1.t: Upon casting an {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skill, the last different {c_important}Potency{/c}, {c_important}Defensive{/c}, or {c_important}Focus{/c} Skill you Cast prior is reset and can be Cast for free up to {c_random}[Affix_Value_1]{/c} times in the next {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds.

legendary_spiritborn_039_x1.t: {c_important}Soar{/c} casts {c_important}Vortex{/c} at its landing location and deals {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.

legendary_spiritborn_040_x1.t: Once an enemy is Slowed by at least {c_number}80%{/c}, they also become Feared for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds. You deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage to Feared enemies.

legendary_spiritborn_041_x1.t: {c_important}Scourge{/c} continuously affects enemies around you for {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1|]{/c} seconds.

legendary_spiritborn_042_x1.t:
{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Up to a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%+|]{/c} chance to create a {c_important}Mystic Circle{/c} for {c_number}[PowerTag.Spiritborn_RuneArea."Script Formula 5"]{/c} seconds. 

Casting a {c_important}Centipede{/c} Skill in {c_important}Mystic Circles{/c} empowers them to periodically apply {c_random}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * Affix_Value_1 * (1 + Owner.Bonus_Percent_Per_Power#Spiritborn_RuneArea)]{/c} Poisoning damage over {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds to enemies within while extending any Crowd Controls affecting them.

legendary_spiritborn_043_x1.t: After you {c_important}Evade{/c}, your next {c_important}Core{/c} Skill dashes to your target and increases your Movement Speed by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%x|]{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds.

legendary_spiritborn_044_x1.t: Every second while moving gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%+|]{/c} Bonus Movement Speed for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds, up to {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100*Affix."Static Value 1"|%+|]{/c}.

legendary_spiritborn_045_x1.t:
{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Up to a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%+|]{/c} chance to create a {c_important}Mystic Circle{/c} for {c_number}[PowerTag.Spiritborn_RuneArea."Script Formula 5"]{/c} seconds. 

Casting a {c_important}Eagle{/c} Skill in {c_important}Mystic Circles{/c} empowers them to move with you and explode for {c_random}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * Affix_Value_1 * (1 + Owner.Bonus_Percent_Per_Power#Spiritborn_RuneArea)]{/c} Lightning damage when you {c_important}Evade{/c}.

legendary_spiritborn_046_x1.t:
{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} {c_important}Eagle{/c} Skills have up to a {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} chance to spawn a {c_important}{u}Storm Feather{/u}{/c} at your target. 

Each {c_important}{u}Storm Feather{/u}{/c} you pick up now also reduces your {c_important}Mobility{/c} Skill Cooldowns by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0" * (1+Owner.Bonus_Percent_Per_Power#Spiritborn_Feather_Spawn)|1|]{/c} seconds.

legendary_spiritborn_047_x1.t: Gain {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} when you Dodge an attack. Your {c_important}Potency{/c} Skills consume {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} to deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.

legendary_spiritborn_048_x1.t: Your {c_important}Defensive{/c} and {c_important}Mobility{/c} Skills gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} Cooldown Rate while moving.

legendary_spiritborn_049.t: Your {c_important}{u}Spirit Storms{/u}{/c} Spark enemies for an additional {c_random}[Affix_Value_1 * 100|%|]{/c} of the {c_important}{u}Spirit Storm's{/u}{/c} total damage over {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds after they leave one.

legendary_spiritborn_050.t:
Rushing Claw deals {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage and is empowered based on how many Charges it has when you Cast it:
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}1:{/c} Heals {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}2:{/c} Guaranteed to {c_important}{u}Overpower{/c}{/u}.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}3:{/c} Guaranteed to {c_important}Critically Strike{/c}.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}4+:{/c} Strikes an additional time.

legendary_spiritborn_051.t: Upon casting an {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skill, the last different {c_important}Potency{/c}, {c_important}Defensive{/c}, or {c_important}Focus{/c} Skill you Cast prior is reset and can be Cast for free up to {c_random}[Affix_Value_1]{/c} times in the next {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds.

legendary_spiritborn_052.t: Enemies you kill while an {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skill is active grants a stack of Supremacy, each increasing your damage by {c_number}[Affix_Value_1*100|x%1|]{/c}, up to {c_number}[Affix_Value_1*Affix."Static Value 0" * 100|x%1|]{/c}. When an {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skill ends, you gain {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} stacks of Supremacy, but you begin to lose one stack every second.

legendary_warlock_001_x2.t:
You gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c} of your Attack Speed as increased damage but no longer attack faster.

Current Bonus: {c_number}[Min(Owner.Attack_Speed_Percent_Bonus_Total, 1)*(Affix_Value_1*100)|2%|]{/c}

legendary_warlock_002_x2.t: While in {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c}, you deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|x1%|]{/c} increased damage for every Demon or enemy Close to you, up to {c_random}[Affix."Static Value 0"*Affix_Value_1|x%|]{/c}.

legendary_warlock_003_x2.t: Your {c_important}Abyss{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%1x|]{/c} increased damage to enemies who have not hit you in the last {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds.

legendary_warlock_004_x2.t: {c_important}{u}Hex{/u}{/c} increases your Critical Strike Chance against an enemy by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1+%|]{/c} per stack.

legendary_warlock_005_x2.t: Killing at least {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} enemies or Demons within {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds increases your damage by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|x%|]{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds.

legendary_warlock_006_x2.t: While moving, gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1x%|]{/c} increased damage for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds, up to {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*Affix."Static Value 1"|x%|]{/c}. Hitting Close enemies refreshes the duration.

legendary_warlock_007_x2.t: While standing still, gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1x%|]{/c} increased {c_important}Greater Demon{/c} Skill damage for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds, up to {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*Affix."Static Value 1"|x%|]{/c}.

legendary_warlock_008_x2.t: {c_important}Occult{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|x2%|]{/c} increased damage against Elite enemies per stack of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} you have. This bonus is doubled if the enemy is {c_important}{u}Hexed{/u}{/c}.

legendary_warlock_009_x2.t: Each hit with {c_important}Demonology{/c} Skills increases the damage you deal with {c_important}Demonology{/c} Skills by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|x1%|]{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds, up to {c_random}[Affix."Static Value 0"*Affix_Value_1|x%|]{/c}.

legendary_warlock_010_x2.t: Your {c_important}Hellfire{/c} Skills deal increased damage equal to {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c} of your Fire Resistance Damage Reduction.

legendary_warlock_011_x2.t: Your {c_important}Abyss{/c} Skills deal increased damage equal to {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c} of your Shadow Resistance Damage Reduction.

legendary_warlock_012_x2.t: Each different {c_important}Occult{/c} Skill you cast increases all your damage by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%1x|]{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds.

legendary_warlock_013_x2.t: If you fail to {c_important}{u}Eviscerate{/u}{/c} an enemy you still apply {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1%|]{/c} of its Bleeding damage for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds.

legendary_warlock_014_x2.t: Skills empowered by {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c} deal an additional {c_number}[60|x%|]{/c} increased damage and you have a {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1%|]{/c} chance for {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c} to persist on casting an empowered Skill.

legendary_warlock_015_x2.t: Making an enemy {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} increases the damage you do to them by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|1x%|]{/c}, up to {c_random}[Affix."Static Value 0"*Affix_Value_1*100|x%|]{/c}.

legendary_warlock_016_x2.t: {c_important}{u}Brimstones{/u}{/c} explode into lava pools, dealing {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c} of their damage over {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds. Standing in lava pools grants you {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c}.

legendary_warlock_017_x2.t: Gain {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction and when you would lose at least {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life, you instead kill Lesser Demons that each absorb up to {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life in damage.

legendary_warlock_018_x2.t: {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c} grants {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction plus an additional {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1%|]{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds any time you take Fire damage, up to {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*Affix."Static Value 1"|%|]{/c}.

legendary_warlock_019_x2.t: Maximum {c_important}{u}Shadowform{/u}{/c} stacks increased by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1]{/c}. Your Shadow Resistance is increased by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|+%|]{/c}.

legendary_warlock_020_x2.t: If no more than {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} of your Demons has been alive for longer than {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds then you gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction and every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"|%|]{/c} Base Life you lose from Direct Damage generates {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3"|1|]{/c} Dominance.

legendary_warlock_021_x2.t: If you have {c_important}{u}Eviscerated{/u}{/c} an enemy in the last {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds, you gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%+|]{/c} increased {c_important}{u}Fortify{/u}{/c} and it refills your Life {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"*100|+%|]{/c} faster. While {c_important}{u}Fortified{/u}{/c} you deal {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"|x%|]{/c} increased Bleeding damage.

legendary_warlock_022_x2.t: While you have {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c}, all incoming Direct Damage is converted into Fire Damage and has a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|%|]{/c} chance to {c_important}{u}Fortify{/u}{/c} you for {c_random}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100*Affix_Value_1|%2|]{/c} of your Maximum Life.

legendary_warlock_023_x2.t: Making an enemy {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} also {c_important}{u}Weakens{/u}{/c} them for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds. {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c} enemies deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1%|]{/c} reduced damage to you.

legendary_warlock_024_x2.t: Whenever your {c_important}{u}Fortify{/u}{/c} exceeds your Current Life, you gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%+|]{/c} increased Resistance to All Elements for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds.

legendary_warlock_025_x2.t: You gain {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} for each {c_random}[Affix_Value_1]{/c} Wrath you gain while at Maximum Wrath.

legendary_warlock_026_x2.t: Summoning a {c_important}Greater Demon{/c} Knocks Down enemies around it for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds. Your {c_important}Lesser Demon{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|x%|]{/c} increased damage to Crowd Controlled enemies.

legendary_warlock_027_x2.t: The duration of any {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c} or {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c} you gain is increased by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%+|]{/c} if you have the other. Your Fire Resistance is increased by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|+%|]{/c}.

legendary_warlock_028_x2.t: {c_important}{u}Hexed{/u}{/c} enemies are Slowed by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds when you make them {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} or become {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds when you Slow them. You deal {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|x%|]{/c} increased damage to {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} enemies.

legendary_warlock_029_x2.t: When killing your Demons, you have a {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} chance for each to count as two kills. Your Life on Kill is increased by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|+%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life.

legendary_warlock_030_x2.t: {c_important}{u}Brimstone{/u}{/c} explosions are {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%|]{/c} larger and deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|x%|]{/c} increased damage. {c_important}{u}Brimstones{/u}{/c} instantly detonate when you run over them in {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c}.

legendary_warlock_031_x2.t: While you have {c_important}{u}Shadowform{/u}{/c}, all incoming Direct Damage is converted into Shadow Damage and has a {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} chance to steal {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} from your attacker. X2_Transfiguration_Mythic_Ahavarion.t: {c_mythic}Gain a random Shrine effect for {c_number}[Affix_Value_1]{/c} seconds after killing an Elite enemy. Can only occur once every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds.{/c}

X2_Transfiguration_Mythic_Andys.t: {c_mythic}{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Up to a {c_number}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} chance to trigger a poison nova that applies {c_number}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * (1 + Owner.Main_Hand_Damage_Percent_Bonus) * Affix_Value_2]{/c} Poisoning damage over {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds to enemies in the area.{/c}

X2_Transfiguration_Mythic_Doombringer.t: {c_mythic}{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Up to a {c_number}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} chance to deal {c_number}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * (1 + Owner.Main_Hand_Damage_Percent_Bonus) * Affix_Value_2]{/c} Shadow damage to surrounding enemies and reduce their damage dealt by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%|]{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds.{/c}

X2_Transfiguration_Mythic_Nesekem.t:
{c_mythic}Every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds, you randomly mark a Nearby enemy. Marked enemies are {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}, and your attacks against them are guaranteed to Critically Strike and {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c}.

Hitting a marked enemy {c_number}[Affix_Value_1]{/c} times clears the mark from them.{/c}

X2_Transfiguration_Mythic_Selig.t:
{c_mythic}Damage is dealt to your Primary Resource before Life and damage taken this way is drastically reduced.

Your Primary Resource is doubled but Maximum Life is reduced by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"*100|%|]{/c}.{/c}

X2_Transfiguration_Mythic_Shako.t: {c_mythic}Gain {c_number}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction. In addition, gain {c_number}+[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} Ranks to all Skills.{/c}

X2_Transfiguration_Mythic_ShatteredVow.t: {c_mythic}Enemies afflicted by more Damage over Time than remaining Life are Executed.{/c}

X2_Transfiguration_Mythic_StarlessSkies.t: {c_mythic}Spending your Primary Resource reduces the Resource cost of your Skills and increases your damage by {c_number}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}[Affix_Value_1 * Affix."Static Value 2"|%x|]{/c}.{/c}

X2_Transfiguration_Mythic_TyraelsMight.t: {c_mythic}Your Skills unleash a divine barrage dealing {c_random}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * Affix_Value_1]{/c} damage.{/c}

drops.sourceName: Maxroll Boss Loot Table Cheat Sheet
rules: All lair bosses require Torment 1 or higher.
Any unique drop can roll as Mythic quality.
Iconic Mythics can drop from every boss.
Belial, Lord of Lies mirrors the loot table of whichever boss you select.
Season 15 uniques drop from the Baal, Mephisto and Diablo capstone dungeons, not from lair bosses.

bosses.name: Grigoire, the Galvanic Saint
bosses.location: Hall of the Penitent, Dry Steppes

capstone.name: Capstone dungeons (Baal, Mephisto, Diablo)
capstone.note: Season 15 uniques can drop from any of the three capstone bosses; Baal is the fastest farm.

runes.sourceName: Maxroll Runewords Overview + Boss Loot Table Cheat Sheet
notes: Runes go in 2-socket Helms, Chest Armor, Pants and 2H Weapons: one Rune of Ritual plus one Rune of Invocation makes a runeword.
A character can have at most 2 runewords. You can't repeat a rune, pair two runes of the same type, or mix gems and runes in one item.
Classic runewords (Enigma, Grief...) are crafted in the Horadric Cube from a normal-quality base item plus runes. An Ancestral base gives an Ancestral runeword.

splinters.name: Splinter of Anguish
splinters.power: {c_unique}You gain {c_random}[{VALUE2}|%+|]{/c} Attack Speed and Critical Strike Chance, but your Primary Resource Costs are increased by {/c}{c_number}[PowerTag.S15_Socketable_Andariel."Script Formula 1" * 100|%|]{/c}.
splinters.flavor:
"Cry out my name as the fires of Hell course through your veins!"
– Andariel, Maiden of Anguish

splinters.name: Splinter of Sin
splinters.power: {c_unique}You gain {c_random}[{VALUE2}|%+|]{/c} Maximum Life, but your Maximum Primary Resource is reduced by {/c}{c_number}[PowerTag.S15_Socketable_Azmodan."Script Formula 1" * 100|%|]{/c}.
splinters.flavor: No matter how you try, the blood you wash from your hands continues to spread.

splinters.name: Splinter of Lies
splinters.power: {c_unique}You gain {c_random}[{VALUE2}|%|]{/c} increased Gold Drop Rate, Crafting Material Drop Rate, and {c_number}[PowerTag.S15_Socketable_Belial."Script Formula 1" * 100|%|]{/c} Bonus Experience, but you are always {c_important}{u}Weakened{/c}{/u} and {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/c}{/u}{/c}.
splinters.flavor:
"How can one be sure this came from his 'true' form? Does such a thing even exist?"
– Tilnan the Collector

splinters.name: Splinter of the Black Soulstone
splinters.power: {c_unique}Your kills absorb a soul for {c_number}[PowerTag.S15_Socketable_BlackSoulstone."Script Formula 2"]{/c} seconds. Each soul increases your damage by {c_random}[{VALUE2}|1%x|]{/c} but increases your damage taken by {c_number}[PowerTag.S15_Socketable_BlackSoulstone."Script Formula 1"* 100|%|]{/c}. This effect stacks up to {c_number}[PowerTag.S15_Socketable_BlackSoulstone."Script Formula 3"]{/c} times, but does not refresh.{/c}
splinters.flavor:
"Abandon your quest, Nephalem. Your allies seek only to control you. With the power I offer, you and I could rule over all creation."
-Zoltun Kulle

splinters.name: Splinter of Pain

splinters.flavor:
"The anticipation of pain is often more exquisite than its fruits. Such is not the case with what I will inflict upon you."
– Duriel, Lord of Pain

splinters.name: Splinter of the Mother
splinters.power: {c_unique}You are {c_important}{u}Unhindered{/u}{/c}. Touching enemies makes them {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[PowerTag.S15_Socketable_Lilith."Script Formula 2"]{/c} seconds. After touching {c_random}[{VALUE2}]{/c} enemies, you are Stunned for {c_number}[PowerTag.S15_Socketable_Lilith."Script Formula 1"]{/c} seconds.
splinters.flavor:
"Break the chains, and discover who you were meant to be. Break the chains, and be beautiful in Sin."
